method.random_split: threshold selected on frozen validation split; model fitted on frozen training split only; applied to saved final test scores
method.block_folds: threshold selected on a 80/20 stratified inner split of the two training blocks (20 seeds); held-out block never used for selection
method.selection_rule: maximum Spam macro-F1; ties broken by maximum margin to the nearest validation score; precision-constrained variant uses validation Spam precision >= 0.90
method.muril_block: fold models were not saved; held-out score diagnostics only, plus a labelled transfer of the seed-42 random-validation threshold
